finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, folder "Bench") has exactly 3 panels, titled:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `fwgr60-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr60-n1 Availability` using the **TestData** data source (default random-walk query; the data source picker defaulted to TestData and the classic randomWalk query fields were present). Stat panel rendered a live value (85.3, later 66.6).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr60-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is `Bench notes for run fwgr60-n1` — includes the runid. Saved ("Dashboard saved" alert).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Tag `bench` added via Dashboard settings → Tags (verified present when settings were reopened). Time range set to `Last 6 hours` and persisted by ticking "Update default time range" in the save dialog before saving. Verified by loading the dashboard with a clean URL (no query params): Grafana itself re-applied `from=now-6h&to=now` from the saved defaults, and the top-bar time picker reads "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval set to `1m` via the top-bar refresh picker, persisted by ticking "Update default refresh value" in the save dialog before saving. Verified on the clean-URL load: Grafana re-applied `refresh=1m` from the saved default and the refresh picker reads "1m" (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfykih2g5nuo0b/fwgr60-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `dfykih2g5nuo0b`, slug `fwgr60-n1-bench-dashboard`.
